clock: 125 MHz intended; this hierarchy has not completed timing closure
admission: begin_valid && begin_ready snapshots context, three bank IDs, three independent generations, three opaque 1024-bit headers and replay request. No same-edge measurement/noise admission for a newly created context.
publication: Actual engine result handshakes directly into qualification_bank_commit. All three owner identities and pending states must match at commit. Statistics precede publication by one owner clock edge.
completion: One held ready/valid event. Published: selected bank, selected frozen header, generation and epoch. Rejected: identity/owner transition failure with no publication. Neither: valid no-range disposition, all three pending banks discarded.
ownership: Map remains reserved through event acceptance, including after the engine retires its context. Event acceptance never releases capture record/replay references.
rejection: begin_rejected pulses on begin_valid without begin_ready, including capacity/duplicate/quiesce. Caller must honor handshake. Delayed results are correlated by all 256 key bits; stale and duplicate measurement/noise are rejected by the engine.
quiesce: Blocks admissions and commit controls; an active commit aborts. Already generated events remain held. Incomplete contexts are not canceled automatically. Coordinated reset and producer drainage are system responsibilities.
integration_requirements: Reserve context/map capacity jointly with capture admission; ADC cannot be backpressured
Result arrival must follow capture completion; early commit rejects rather than waiting
Exclusive stats/publish/discard ownership for participating banks
Do not reuse full identity while delayed producers can still return an old result
Construct and validate selected record headers according to frame ABI upstream
Connect published events to record descriptor acceptance; release bank refs only using validated reader completion
Coordinate rst with bank owner and all producers/consumers; idle is local map drainage only
